messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: release/2026-03-20. Service: routing-service -> prod. Canary 1% + feature-flag rollout planned for `ff/route-cohort-v2`.

maria: starting manual preflight checks now. will pin model routing to v2 for canary only. cc @jordan @sam :eyes:

jordan: noted. ramp plan below. happy to hand off monitoring.

maria: ramp plan:

0) set `ff/route-cohort-v2` = off

1) deploy canary w/ flag ON for cohort=internal (1%) -> soak 10m
2) if OK -> expand to 10% (10m soak)
3) if OK -> 50% (30m soak)
4) then 100% cutover with 30m final soak

Rollback triggers (any -> rollback to last pinned variant):
- error-rate increase > 0.8% absolute or 3x baseline
- p95 latency increase > 50% over baseline
- user-facing regressions from smoke prompts (embedding mismatch > 0.07)
- any DB or downstream capacity alarms

pri: adding oncall thresholds to the runbook now. will add these thresholds to prometheus alerts and a paging rule.

sam: will watch infra (gpu queue length + burst). If we see queue depth > 60% sustained for 5m, throttle the rollout to previous step.

rachel: product note — feature is behind opt-in cohort, we pushed a small release note to staging. if we need rollback, notify support with the template below.

dylan: support template acknowledged. I'll standby for customer outreach.

maria: pinning routing model for canary with command:

```
ctl model pin routing-model:v2 --env=prod --scope=cohort=internal
```

maria: toggling `ff/route-cohort-v2` to ON for internal cohort now.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: cohort=internal (1%) -> instances: a12,a13,a14. Build: b2026.03.20-21

jordan: quick smoke: sending 20 synthetic requests through canary routing. all responses good. p50 42ms p95 110ms

pri: prometheus dashboards green, no alerts so far. adding a short-lived trace link: https://traces.internal/r/2625016789

sam: infra note: if GPU util > 85% for more than 7m, will start queue shedding. that's a hard stop.

maria: moving to 10% in 10m unless any flags. going to update the rollback checklist in the runbook.

jordan: added an automated rollback webhook if error-rate spike detected: `ops/rollback-hook` -> will trigger drain + toggle ff off.

rachel: FYI, release notes snippet reserved: "Routing improvements for internal cohort — improved latency and stability for multi-turn inference." will not ship to customers until 50%.

dylan: ACK. support on standby with canned message.

maria: 10% ON -> started. soak timer 10m.

[10m later]

pri: 10m soak complete, metrics stable. p95 remained within +12%. no user regressions flagged.

maria: proceed to 50% -> starting. soak 30m.

sam: infra looks fine. small transient queue spike at +2m but recovered.

jordan: note: comparing embeddings drift metrics — delta = 0.021, within tolerance.

maria: 50% soak in progress.

[30m later]

pri: 50% soak complete. no alerts. no regressions. ready for 100%.

maria: before 100%: final sanity checks -> pin global default route to stable fallback for quick rollback:

```
rld pin route default -> routing-model:v1
```

maria: cutting over to 100% now.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: `ff/route-cohort-v2` = ON for all cohorts. Build b2026.03.20-21

jordan: post-cutover quick smoke looks good. p95 avg 115ms.

[Monitoring window 30m]

pri: 12m into post-cutover window — seeing a small error bump to 0.45% (baseline 0.18%) but below threshold. keeping an eye.

sam: GPU queues stable. no infra alarms.

maria: 25m in — metrics holding. since all green, I'll update release notes and close the rollout doc.

rachel: prepping customer-facing notes for tomorrow release bulletin.

dylan: closing standby.

maria: final: release/2026-03-20 -> prod confirmed. rollbook updated with timestamps and pinned versions. tagging @everyone in the release doc.

---

If rollback had been triggered we would have run:
```
ops rollback release/2026-03-20 --to=build-b2026.03.18 && ctl ff set ff/route-cohort-v2=false --scope=all
```

and notify oncall + support with the incident template.
